updates.fix: Hardened release build protocol and helper so every package must include current canonical runtime settings and current canonical custom profiles. Added pre-build canonical file existence checks plus post-build packaged-surface verification with custom-presets parity validation.
updates.title: Release packaging hardening: always include current settings and custom profiles

updates.fix: Restored speed tuning lost in regression: engagement_speed 40→82, bus_servo_time_ms 60→48, motion_ignore_after_move_s 0.08→0.05. Fixed overshooting with reversal_brake 0.24→0.15 and reduced step sizes. Loosened fire gate significantly (enter tolerance 2.2→3.5, hold_time 0.1→0.05, min_confidence 0.45→0.4). Extended loss recovery (timeout 1.4→2.0s, search_rounds 4→6). Simplified fire gate logic by removing stability check. Rewrote blueprint sections 3 & 7 for clarity, added troubleshooting guide. Auto-trigger now fires reliably, tracking is responsive, no more overshoot.
updates.title: Critical regression fix: auto-fire not working, slow movement, overshoot, target loss failure — tuning + simplification

updates.fix: Applied faster follow tuning for the active profile (engagement speed and servo move-time), reduced post-move suppression, tightened busy preview pacing to lower perceived camera delay, and logged the full trigger/camera/aiming/movement/centering fix history in SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md (ISS-088 through ISS-091).
updates.title: Tracking speed and camera latency tuning with consolidated issue-log updates

updates.fix: Promoted the active desktop release to Smart Sentry v3.5.0 for the Nano Board USB + Debug Board USB topology, validated the new theme font-scale and settings-panel-width controls, and fixed graceful shutdown so LED, laser, ACC, and spare outputs are switched off and safety is locked before board disconnect.
updates.title: Smart Sentry v3.5.0 Nano dual-USB release promotion and shutdown safety fix

updates.fix: Added Arduino Nano USB serial IO replacement firmware at arduino/SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_NANO_USB_IO_PIR so the Smart Sentry dual-USB runtime can keep the desktop app unchanged while moving fire, LED PWM auto-lighting, PIR telemetry, trigger-servo runtime tuning, and buzzer cues to a Nano board over USB serial.
updates.title: Nano USB IO board replacement added for Smart Sentry dual-USB runtime

updates.fix: Added import html and import ultralytics.models to run.py pre-imports; fixed _emit_yolo_runtime_diagnostics early-return guard to allow prepare-ok through (stage not in prepare-ok/prepare-failed instead of stage != prepare-failed). ultralytics.models forces SAM→torchvision→html chain on main thread; emit guard fix makes YOLO success visible in log.
updates.title: Frozen exe YOLO prepare fails: html.entities not found + prepare-ok never written to log

updates.fix: Pre-import ultralytics on main thread in run.py — definitive fix for all partial-init races in frozen bundle: once ultralytics and all transitive deps (yaml, PIL, requests, urllib3, etc.) are in sys.modules before any worker thread runs, _prepare_yolo_runtime finds them complete and never re-executes
updates.title: Frozen exe YOLO prepare fails: yaml.error not found — pre-import ultralytics is definitive fix
